findings.summary: The journey now runs the revoke operation (b3: sharing revoked, pending deliveries cancelled, Block recorded) before the owner confirms or cancels at b6, so the cancel path reaches e2 'No block recorded' after a block was already recorded, contradicting the affordance effect and the criterion.
findings.evidence: b2 next: b3; b3 'Participant authority checked; sharing revoked; pending deliveries cancelled; Block recorded' next: b6; b6 cancel -> e2 'No block recorded' vs affordance effect 'Nothing is revoked or recorded until the owner confirms in BlockConfirmDialog' and criterion 'Cancelling a block confirmation leaves sharing and pending jobs untouched'
